judgments.reason: The model notes a +3 auction commission reduces net cost (B-3) but does not articulate the specific mechanism that commissions are applied before payment allowing bids above available coins to succeed or an observed instance of such overbidding.

The model observed clerk revelations of a rival bid but did not claim or exploit the mechanism that waiting reveals committed rival bids before the focal player commits so they can respond; the focal was already committed and did not change a bid based on revealed values.

judgments.quote: At the 8-round maximum with lot 0 unresolved and no other lots auctioned, closing ends the game and calculates final scores.
judgments.reason: The model explicitly states that the 8-round horizon causes unresolved lots to remain unsold and that closing at that horizon ends the game; the transcript shows the focal calling close at round 8 and settlement accepted, matching the articulated mechanism.
judgments.evidence_gate: No observed discrepancy satisfying this mechanism in the focal transcript.

judgments.reason: The model describes the +3 commission for auction winners but does not claim or demonstrate that catalog purchases receive that commission; no articulation or observed evidence of commission on buys is present.
